//: The soak harness drives the app's own generation path, not a copy of it.
`generations.ts` and the repository layer are compiled to scripts/soak/.build with tsc,
because plain `node` cannot import a .ts file that its neighbours address as `./x.js`.
tsc is already a devDependency; the alternative was re-implementing the turn, which
would soak code that ships nowhere. Same trade as scripts/perf/tsconfig.json.
